stage: Frozen before boundary tests, fresh collection, labels or fitting; repaired early-transposition boundary
selection: Repair family independence and double the data while holding feature representation, fitting objective/hyperparameters and strength gates fixed. Prior split and failed weights untouched.

generation.opening_method: Seeded uniform choice among pinned full-strength Stockfish MultiPV8 at5000nodes, through8plies. Reject any candidate rollout that touches a blocked canonical position fromply4 onward. Block all previous inspected histories, query/PV paths, witness leaves, old controls and reserved confirmation paths. Preserve all rejected attempts and raw queries; no outcome-based rejection.
generation.continuation: Through64plies or gameover: alternate taggedv0.18 at25ms and full-strength Stockfish at5000nodes, swap student color by family index. Offline training rollouts, not strength games.

independence: Canonical first4FEN fields with legal EP, min(original,color/rankmirror); ignore counters only. Record every rollout board fromply4, union whole new families sharing ANY such board transitively, then split connected components. Exclude whole families touching prior/reserved canonical positions before labels. Independently reconstruct histories and audit zero prior/reserved hits and zero cross-split board overlap before branch labels. Repeat audit after leaf extraction; cross-split or prior collisions in selected leaf paths stop fitting rather than resplit consumed labels.
splits: Seeded shuffle sorted connected-component IDs; firstfloor60% train, nextfloor20% validation, remainder holdout. Freeze membership before branch labels. Require>=64components, >=300raw roots, >=60raw roots each validation/holdout; after unchanged terminal/nonstatic/mate exclusion require>=50eligible roots in each validation/holdout. Any failure stops this batch without extending it for favorable outcomes.
alternatives: Pinned full-strength Stockfish MultiPV3 at50000nodes plus actual taggedv0.18 100ms move; union all legal unique moves. Label each restricted move at50000nodes with freshHash64 Threads1 Skill20, all score iterations and last exact. Branch-score loss allows25cp uncertainty; any good alternative counts. Mate labels retained separately.
student_leaf: For every alternative, full-window releasedv0.18 depth3 root equivalent (childdepth2), full supplied history. Reconstruct an exact scalar witness through main/q search, with same SEE/capture/evasion/safety/repetition eligibility, until a static leaf. Validate witness baseWhite*rootcolor equals exact branch value. Terminal/repetition/checked-cap/nonfinite rows retained but excluded from fit. This frozen-leaf approximation is a surrogate, not actual candidate-search evidence.
features: Reuse corrected archived allocation-free12feature geometry and oracle; no old weights. Independently check all new leaf vectors and phase against pythonchess. SignedWhite-minusBlack, tapered middle/end24integer coefficients. Original v0.18 base exact.

fitting.target: Within-root pairwise teacher gap clipped+/-400 minus baseline branch gap; ignore pairs<=25cp apart. Weight1+min(3,(abs(gap)-25)/100), ridge scaled on training RMS only. Nonnegative bounded coordinate solve, integer round; no intercept.
fitting.selection: Includezero. On validation choose lowest mean regret among fits with severe>300 positions<=baseline+1; ties prefer stronger regularization then smallerL1. Mean regret of tied predicted best alternatives; loss=max(0,teacherbest-selected-25) capped1000. Write frozen weights before first holdout metrics.

surrogate_gate: Same nonzero model and >=5% holdout mean decision-regret improvement, severe>300 positions<=baseline+1; at least50finite eligible holdout roots. No fit/gate/weight adjustment after result.
downstream: Only after surrogate/independent-feature gates: activate distinctly named candidate; exact integer scalar/color/mate/draw/tactical tests and race/vet/build/wrapper; zero allocations and combined inference<=400ns in same cost cohort. Native serial/three-search/warm controls against taggedv0.18. New holdout actual100ms3trials/1000ms1trial decisions: finite-node reference mean loss no worse thanbaseline+max(5cp,10%) and severe<=baseline+2 at both budgets. Retain old84public controls separately. Then standard50peropponent allthreeconcurrent if promising. No automatic larger confirmation.
stop: Preserve any failure and source. No guessed weights on inspected controls, no live Lichess, no commit/push/PR until check-in.
boundary_controls: Before engines: early move-order transposition positive, distinct position negative, color/rank mirrors, counters ignored, legal versus unusable en passant, castling-right distinction, terminal-root retention, transitive family union, blocked late position, post-split collision rejection and whole-component split. Separate postcollection auditor reconstructs boards independently, never trusts saved keys.
